blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Pump prices are set to rise sharply today, with gasoline prices potentially rising by as much as P5 per liter. Diesel prices are expected to increase by P2 to P2.50 per liter, while gasoline prices could go up by P4.50 to P5 per liter. The projected increases were attributed to recent price movements in Asia and fluctuations in foreign exchange rates.
